Create Outbound Shipment.description: Creates a new outbound shipment from a store to a receiving facility.

Update Outbound Shipment Status.description: Moves one or more outbound shipments to a new status, such as PICKED or SHIPPED.

Register Patient.description: Inserts a new patient record into a dispensary store.

Create Request Requisition.description: Creates an internal order (request requisition) to a supplying store.

Create Inbound Shipment.description: Records a new inbound shipment (goods receipt) from a supplier.

Get Items With Stats.description: Lists the item catalogue for a store, including stock statistics.

Get Stock On Hand.description: Lists available stock lines (batches) in a store.

Find Expiring Stock.description: Finds stock lines that expire before a given date.

Find Patient By Code.description: Looks up a patient by their patient code or national ID.

List Sent Requisitions.description: Lists requisitions with a given status, e.g. SENT, for reporting.

Get Temperature Breaches.description: Lists unacknowledged cold-chain temperature breaches for a store.

List Suppliers.description: Lists names flagged as suppliers visible to a store.
